description: Search one deck. `query` substring-matches the term, its reading/pronunciation, its English meanings, and its category, so "bone" finds entries glossed as bone and "ㄱ" finds that jamo. Narrow with `category` (exact, from list_decks) or `difficulty` (1-5; for the kanji deck this is the school grade). Paginated via `offset`.

difficulty.description: Exact difficulty/grade filter (1-5; kanji deck = grade 1-6)

query.description: Substring to match against term, reading, meanings, category

name: search_deck
